description: This Rust source file defines a ConfigSet struct for managing configuration files in memory, including methods for adding files, retrieving integer and string values, and handling resource cleanup. It also includes unit tests for its functionality.

classes.name: ConfigSet
classes.description: An in-memory cache for configuration files such as `.gitmodules` or `.gitconfig`, supporting adding files and retrieving configuration values.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new ConfigSet instance by allocating resources.

methods.name: add_files
methods.description: Loads multiple configuration files into the ConfigSet, overriding conflicting directives.

methods.name: get_int
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value as an integer, returning None if not present.

methods.name: get_string
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value as a String, returning None if not present.
